name: schemastud
description: The @schemastud JS package family — a single npm workspace. Packages stay at their existing top-level paths so the fleet's file: overlays and the live FC/RCP wiring keep resolving unchanged.
//workspaces: Listed in TOPOLOGICAL order (leaves first) so `npm run build --workspaces` builds each package after the @schemastud deps whose .d.ts it needs: seam/facets (leaves) -> blockdoc/frame-remote -> mainframe/frame -> chat. If the graph outgrows a hand-ordered list, adopt a graph-aware runner (Turborepo/Nx) rather than maintaining this by hand. (beam-mdx lives in the separate `beam` app-substrate monorepo — same @schemastud npm scope. big-calendar is tracked here but DELIBERATELY not a workspace: it keeps its own lockfile and node_modules because its RBC/date-fns/react-query surface is host-provided peers, so root installs skip it and beam-calendar links it by file: — run `npm run build:big-calendar` before building beam. Whether to admit it as a workspace leaf is an open owner question, architecture-pass A5-C2 2026-10-18; this comment records the exclusion so it stops being unwritten fleet lore.)

scripts.build:big-calendar: npm --prefix big-calendar install && npm --prefix big-calendar run build
